people.name: a_wife_of_Ezekiel
people.line: Wife of Ezekiel - Died as a sign to Israel

translations.web: So I spoke to the people in the morning; and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.
translations.bsb: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. And the next morning I did as I had been commanded.
translations.kjv: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
translations.asv: So I spake unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
